subject: Add inline keyword to ostream operator overloads for better linking on macOS and build compatibility. (#419)
reason: The change only adds the inline keyword to three ostream operator<< overloads defined in headers (fixing duplicate-symbol link errors on macOS) and adds a macOS CI workflow file. Adding inline to header-defined functions changes linkage, not semantics: the compiled module behaves identically at runtime, no command reply, indexing, replication or persistence path changes. It is a build/CI compatibility fix with no testable behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
